description: Index of the Hyperliquid Parquet archive and download links to its files. One file per UTC day for `fills` (every fill), `positions` (every 5-minute snapshot of every open position), `positions_hourly` (every position as last seen in each hour), `cohorts_hourly` (the hourly cohort matrix of every asset) and `wallets_hourly` (each wallet's native perp account per hour), from 2026-05-01, plus `latest`, one `positions` file of the current open positions replaced every 5 minutes. view='datasets' (default) lists the published days with each file's `rows` and `bytes`, the column `schema` of every dataset and the free samples' folder. view='url' resolves exactly ONE file (`dataset` and `date`) to a link valid for 7 days (`expires_at`) that needs no API key: this tool never downloads anything, so fetch it yourself and do not share it. A day appears once it is complete (the early UTC morning after). Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/archive/datasets and /archive/url.

date.description: view=url only, required there: a published UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD, or `latest` (`positions` only: the current open positions).

view.description: datasets = the index (default); url = a link to one file.

name: hl_archive
